long_biography.plain_text:
Product design was Oscar Marchetto's starting point. In the early 1990s he helped establish Nice, taking responsibility for research and development in its building-automation business. His next chapter began in 2013, when he joined the ownership team of a distressed glazing specialist. He worked with its incumbent managers to stabilise operations and concentrate investment on passenger-vessel projects.

The revived company, Somec, then widened into professional kitchens, bespoke interiors and civil façades. Acquisitions and a stock-market listing supported the assembly of specialist manufacturers under one group. Marchetto still directs strategy as chairman, chief executive and indirect majority shareholder. He also helped launch Fabbrica in the United States, carrying the group's engineering expertise from marine glazing into the façades of major buildings.
